proposal.observation: Round 1's oblique-Hough relaxation was accepted and improved correspondence_f1@15 from 0.1717 to 0.1819 while fill, ring count, and depth NaN ratio were unchanged. The before/after images retain all 10 regularly spaced prompts and essentially unchanged segmentation, but accepted oblique lines remain sparse and concentrated on the right side.
proposal.rule: For low oblique-line yield with fragmented joint traces, continue the accepted detection relaxation by lowering the oblique Hough threshold; preserve the maximum line gap and all stages whose measurements remained healthy.
proposal.rationale: The isolated round-1 response provides direct case-specific evidence that relaxing oblique detection improves the weak correspondence feature without harming coverage or ring count. Lowering hough_threshold_oblique from the accepted incumbent value of 30 to its bounded minimum of 20 is the smallest new continuation; unfolding remains untouched because stage 1 is locked.
